title: Admin Login
description: Management access starts with a secure staff account. Admin privileges and account status are checked by the server.

title: Management Dashboard
description: Organization workload, client assignments and current workflow progress are summarized from permitted records.

title: User Management
description: Create and maintain staff identities, roles, departments, team membership and reporting managers.

title: Team Management
description: Organize employees into teams with department, lead, capacity and visibility settings.

title: Departments
description: Maintain the department directory used by teams and staff profiles.

title: Roles & Permissions
description: Inspect and configure permission policies. Backend checks control management, client access and automation actions.

title: Client Allocation
description: Upload the allocation Excel, validate employee mappings and import client, registration and financial-year assignments.

title: Client Organizations
description: Manage external client organizations, owners and links to internal clients. This mapping determines client data visibility.

title: Subscription Plans
description: Maintain plan pricing, service coverage and usage limits for client organizations.

title: Client Requests
description: Inspect organization service requests and administrative onboarding records. This is separate from the consultation inbox.

title: SaaS Overview
description: Review organization, subscription and service-request totals from the application database.

title: Clients
description: Browse authorized client and registration assignments and their financial-year workflow states.

title: Tasks & Personal To-do
description: Managers assign work with a title, description, deadline and employee. Users also maintain private personal to-dos.

title: Client Data Publishing
description: Select the client and unit, upload final Excel, preview supported sheets and publish directly. History records publications; consultation requests appear below.

title: ExtractBot
description: Open Login launches the isolated CPCB session. Complete OTP manually, then use Scrape All and Available. The final workbook is offered for download.

title: Data Upload Bot
description: Choose PWP or PIBO. PIBO branches into Sales or Purchase, and Sales into Domestic or Export. Validate the appropriate Excel and invoice inputs before submission.

title: Delete Bot
description: Prepare a scoped PWP production-record deletion. Record selection, authorization and explicit confirmation protect destructive portal actions.

title: Pending Approvals
description: Review permitted approval and deletion requests. Visibility follows the configured role and reporting scope.

title: Reports & Analytics
description: View permitted organization or personal workflow statistics and download available reporting formats.

title: AI Assistant
description: Ask platform and workflow questions. Provider-dependent responses require configured integration; the assistant does not bypass permissions.

title: Audit Logs
description: Inspect recorded application events, actors and timestamps for management traceability.

title: Profile & Settings
description: View account identity, role and department; use the password-change flow to maintain account access.

title: PIBO Upload Type
description: The selection dialog separates Sales from Purchase / Procurement; each workflow uses its own schema.

title: PIBO Sales Destination
description: Select Domestic or Export before choosing the corresponding source files.

title: Consultation Reply
description: Read the client topic and question, then reply with In Progress, Awaiting Client or Resolved. Replies appear in the same client-side consultation thread.

title: User Login
description: Employees and managers sign in here. The server applies role and client-assignment permissions.

title: Management Dashboard
description: Organization workload, client assignments and current workflow progress are summarized from permitted records.

title: Clients
description: Browse authorized client and registration assignments and their financial-year workflow states.

title: Tasks & Personal To-do
description: Managers assign work with a title, description, deadline and employee. Users also maintain private personal to-dos.

title: Client Data Publishing
description: Select the client and unit, upload final Excel, preview supported sheets and publish directly. History records publications; consultation requests appear below.

title: ExtractBot
description: Open Login launches the isolated CPCB session. Complete OTP manually, then use Scrape All and Available. The final workbook is offered for download.

title: Data Upload Bot
description: Choose PWP or PIBO. PIBO branches into Sales or Purchase, and Sales into Domestic or Export. Validate the appropriate Excel and invoice inputs before submission.

title: Delete Bot
description: Prepare a scoped PWP production-record deletion. Record selection, authorization and explicit confirmation protect destructive portal actions.

title: Reports & Analytics
description: View permitted organization or personal workflow statistics and download available reporting formats.

title: Profile & Settings
description: View account identity, role and department; use the password-change flow to maintain account access.

title: Manager Tasks
description: The manager can assign tasks to authorized employees with a deadline and follow progress. Personal to-dos remain separate.

title: Manager Approvals
description: Managers see requests within their reporting scope. No fabricated portal job or approval result is shown.

title: Client Login
description: External clients use their separate organization login. BOT controls and internal administration are not available in this portal.

title: Business Dashboard
description: Published workbook data drives certificate quantities, procurement charts, expiry distribution and source refresh information.

title: My Companies & Units
description: Browse linked companies, units and registrations. Filter the scope and compare published quantities without counting duplicate logins twice.

title: Certificate Inventory
description: Browse Available-sheet certificate records, categories, processing types, quantities and validity. Filters and pagination support record exploration.

title: Expiry Monitoring
description: View validity windows and upcoming certificate expiry quantities. This is informational monitoring; certificate action/review requests have been removed.

title: Procurement Analytics
description: Analyze Procurement data by supplier, registration type, category, unit and financial year. Export Excel or a branded PDF with matching procurement records.

title: Reconciliation
description: Compare Procurement Summary and detail totals for the same financial year and category. Differences are observations, not confirmed errors; missing-field issue tables are not shown.

title: SPOC & Advisory Support
description: See assigned contacts and reporting managers. Submit a topic and question through Request Consultation, then read staff replies and track status.

title: Reports & Management Insights
description: Download reports generated from the active published scope. PDF downloads support an optional company logo; source timestamps and report definitions provide context.

title: Notifications
description: Read published-data, certificate and consultation updates. Consultation replies link back to SPOC & Advisory Support.

title: Subscription & Billing
description: Review plan and billing information. Razorpay sandbox checkout is separate from live entitlement; missing provider configuration is shown honestly.

title: Settings & Data Governance
description: Inspect organization identity, data coverage, access permissions, retention and reporting preferences.

title: Request Consultation
description: Enter the subject, topic, company, unit, question and preferred date. The internal consultation inbox receives the request for authorized follow-up.

title: PDF Branding & Download
description: Optionally upload a company PNG/JPEG logo, or download without one. The generated report includes A A GARG & CO branding and the selected source scope.

title: Portal Accounts
description: Manage client portal account groupings. One organization can have multiple accounts and registrations across supported portal types.

title: CPCB Registrations
description: Maintain unit registration IDs and financial years. Verified registration ownership and organization scope govern access.

title: Client Documents
description: Upload and manage permitted supporting documents within configured file and storage limits.

title: Subscription Usage
description: Inspect configured service allowances and usage. Availability follows the organization contract.

title: Plan Catalog
description: Inspect published commercial plans and available term options. No purchase is initiated for documentation.

title: Billing Details
description: Maintain the organization billing contact and billing identity used by supported financial workflows.

title: Activity History
description: View organization activity records and timestamps for authorized client operations.

title: Create User
description: Set staff identity, team, department, role and reporting manager. A one-time password setup flow follows creation; passwords are not shared in this guide.

title: Create Team
description: Define the team code, department, lead and operating settings before assigning employees.

title: Create Department
description: Maintain reusable department names and codes for user and team records.

title: Allocation Preview
description: Review parsed assignment rows and employee mappings before import. Re-import behavior protects existing mappings and avoids duplicate assignment records.

title: Workbook Preview & Publish
description: The final workbook is ready for direct publication after parsing. Select retention and publish; no separate manager approval or review-note checkbox is required.

title: Assign Employee Task
description: Choose an authorized employee and enter title, description, priority and deadline. The assigned task appears in that employee Tasks page.

title: Create Personal To-do
description: Employees can create personal reminders and track their own task status independently of manager-assigned work.

title: Delete Bot Setup
description: Choose the supported production year before logging into the scoped portal session. This screenshot does not execute a portal deletion.
